digest.component_or_area: Gerrit CI/CD verification workflow and documentation validation
propositions: Documentation-only patchsets must execute a reduced verification lane containing only documentation gates (ADR validation, index checks, drift detection, quickstart validation, DCO/criteria checks) while skipping the full OS/Python matrix, mutation, packaging, optionality, artifact, eval, golden-path, and identity jobs.

Path-based routing decision must execute exclusively from trusted origin/main via a classifier job that compares the exact patchset diff (HEAD^..HEAD) against a maintained allowlist, with fail-closed fallback to full Verify on any uncertainty (Python/shell/workflow/config/test/unknown paths, malformed diffs, or classifier failure).

Shared documentation gates must be extracted once into a composite action at .github/actions/docs-gates/action.yml and invoked by both full and docs-only routes after checkout/setup, eliminating copied command lists and maintaining all current documentation-related assertions without adding runner jobs.

Classifier job failure must block Verified and trigger full-route execution simultaneously, preventing both unverified route decisions from voting green and pure documentation changes from consuming the full runner graph.

Production measurement must demonstrate that a genuine docs-only change (e.g., CHANGELOG.md-only) consumes approximately 82% less wall time and 94% fewer runner-minutes than the baseline full route, while a genuine non-doc change still executes the complete full verification suite.
